advocatjuh: "You're late," said the corporal when Jonas Advocatjuh arrived on Day 12. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
arch_izu: Marek Izu unpacked his mother's thimble at R-F9. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Marek Izu wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Marek Izu put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar, grazed.
Marek Izu laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

Marek Izu raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Edmund Crack of the Concord (@voktor__crack). Hill 304 has been won. Marek Izu listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Marek Izu is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Marek Izu fired at a movement across the wire at R-F9. The man went down: Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, gravely wounded.
Marek Izu fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Hugo Rock, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Tobias Htmmci of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Marek Izu kept the tin.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Marek Izu let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Marek Izu was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F9, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02). Marek Izu was killed outright at R-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02).

Konrad Izu had heard about Marek Izu's courage. At R-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The clerk counted the names twice. Konrad Izu is number 121 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Konrad Izu watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Konrad Izu was waiting. Marek Joaotomas was badly wounded.
chrisspowerss: Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers stepped off the supply cart at T-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. Orders came through: Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pocket Bible with a hole in it.

Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Yann Thesenorfry, grazed. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Kid of the Concord (@cappa_kid). A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
deposito_78: Bram Deposito, a carpenter from Coldwater, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in P-F12. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

At the Ossuary Wood, Isidor Jro of the Concord and Bram Deposito of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bram Deposito helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Bram Deposito rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Isidor Gallianrecon was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
drawtoss: On Day 10, Cyril Drawtoss arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Cyril Drawtoss was faster. Nils Reynolds was gravely wounded. Cyril Drawtoss had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Leopold "Mole" Blacksmithsb was badly wounded. Cyril Drawtoss walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Cyril Drawtoss fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F11. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
emmanuelgomez1: The sergeant gave Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Valentin Abapo of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome kept the tin. Victory at Grey Mill. Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
ferkness: At the depot, Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness had practised answering to his name. At Q-F13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In Q-F13, Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
hmmm_m7225: Dietrich Hmmm reported to T-F16 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Hmmm watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Dietrich Hmmm borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Hmmm wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Dietrich Hmmm pulled Zeno Beaucookie out of a flooded shell hole at Hill 304. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
jonnystokes_photography: Pavel Photography reported to P-F5 with a tin of tobacco sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Arno Man and Pavel Photography carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Pavel Photography read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Pavel Photography discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
sup.0452: Emil Sup left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Stoneyford and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he talks to his rifle.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Emil Sup aimed just below it. Matthias "Saint" Industriousb was grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Emil Sup watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Emil Sup waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F11 with the rations. Emil Sup ate while listening to the revised orders.
Emil Sup lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
the_next7up: Yann Next introduced himself as a baker from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Yann Next closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann Next watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Yann Next wrote a letter for Anselm Ddebb's mother, because Anselm could not find the words. Anselm signed it.
